bin.value_basis: fraction of the wafer-process dies whose left+right bin pair fullmatches the DF_SYMBOL_BIN regex of this parameter

yield.value_basis: fraction of the wafer-process dies whose left+right bin pair equals the pass-bin pair; the pass-bin symbol is defined by the source data contract

source_guides.guidance: Use source map for drawing, coordinates, binmap, and cumulative-map questions.

Use source wafer_parameter for numeric yield, fail-number, ranking, and average questions; PT1H and PT1C parameters are the pass-pair die fraction of that process; select parameters by PARAM_KIND from metric_definitions.
For yield (수율), use parameter PT1H unless a process is specified; then use the yield-kind parameter for that process.
